description.BUTTONS: Read the rules, then press **Verify** below to unlock the rest of the server.
description.SELECT: Read the rules, then pick **Verify** in the menu below to unlock the rest of the server.
description.REACTIONS: Read the rules, then react with ✅ below to unlock the rest of the server.

description.BUTTONS: Pick the announcements you want to be pinged for. Press a button again to stop.
description.SELECT: Pick the announcements you want to be pinged for. Your choice replaces your current notification roles.
description.REACTIONS: React to get pinged for an announcement type. Remove your reaction to stop.

panel.title: 💬 Pronoun Roles
panel.description: Pick the pronouns you go by. You can hold more than one.

roleTemplates.label: Colors

panel.title: 🎨 Color Roles
panel.description: Pick a color for your name. You can hold one color at a time; pick another to switch.

roleTemplates.note: A color only shows when its role sits above a member's other colored roles, so drag the color roles up in **Server Settings → Roles** (they stay below my highest role).

panel.title: 🎂 Age Roles
panel.description: Pick your age group. You can hold one at a time.

panel.title: 🗺️ Region Roles
panel.description: Pick the part of the world you live in.

panel.title: 🎮 Platform Roles
panel.description: Pick the platforms you play on. You can hold more than one.

panel.title: ✉️ DM Roles
panel.description: Let others know whether you are open to direct messages.

roleTemplates.label: Ping roles

panel.title: 🔔 Ping Roles
panel.description: Pick what you want to be pinged for. You can hold as many as you like.

roleTemplates.note: The roles are created not mentionable, so only members allowed to mention @everyone can ping them.

roleTemplates.label: Timezones: US

panel.title: 🌍 Timezone Roles
panel.description: Pick your timezone so `/timestamp` reads your times right. You can hold one timezone role at a time; pick another to switch.

roleTemplates.note: Each role is linked to its timezone, so `/timestamp` reads a member's times in the zone they pick; a member's own `/timezone set` still wins over the role.
